timing_rules.end_to_end: All five phases with equivalent source/input ownership and release points; record outer process wall time separately
timing_rules.prepared_input: Repeat phase 4 with already admitted/imported input and fresh logical and physical budgets; never relabel as end-to-end
timing_rules.warmup: Execute the same candidate and case once, fully observe, and release references before the measured invocation; report warmup separately
timing_rules.rss: Whole-process peak, including warmup and retained fixtures; not an operation's RSS delta
timing_rules.storage: Report live/peak container slots, typed buffer bytes, NULL storage, copied cells and allocations separately; count shared buffers once physically, logical occurrences per contract
timing_rules.conversion: Count input capture plus destination buffers while both are alive, including transient selections
timing_rules.oracle: Closed-form fixture expectations plus A/B/C semantic comparison; never derive expected output only from the tested comparator

adoption.improvement: At least one preselected major group improves end-to-end time or whole-process peak RSS by at least 20 percent in every member on native, with paired reproducibility; report other metrics without treating incomparable slot counts as bytes
adoption.reproducibility: At least 6 of 7 paired samples agree in direction and the deterministic paired-bootstrap 95 percent interval excludes no change; publish all samples and interval method
adoption.regression: Any reproducible end-to-end slowdown in another mandatory case or target prevents automatic adoption, even if memory improves; no averaging it away
adoption.uncertainty: Missing, noisy, mixed or semantically incomparable evidence means hold; retain rows
adoption.cross_target: No native-only rollout or backend-specific engine introduced automatically
adoption.migration: A clear prototype win only authorizes full scoped migration and remeasurement, not a completion claim
